overview.clientLine: Your portal for {clients}. Projects, documents, invoices and support in one place.
overview.noClient: Your account is not linked to a client yet. Contact CyBarq to complete the setup.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Projects CyBarq is delivering for you, with milestones, updates and shared documents.
projects.emptyDescription: Projects appear here once CyBarq makes them visible to you.
projects.notFoundDescription: This project does not exist or is not visible to your account.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Every file shared with you across your projects.
documents.emptyDescription: Documents shared by CyBarq, and files you upload on a project, appear here.
documents.uploadHint: Files you upload are visible to the CyBarq team on this project. Up to 50 MB.
documents.documentTitleHint: Optional. Defaults to the file name.

finance.title: Quotes and invoices
finance.description: Documents issued to you. Each one can be downloaded as a PDF.
finance.quoteInstructions: To accept or decline a quote, reply to the email it was sent with or contact sales@cybarq.com. Online acceptance will be added in a later release.
finance.paymentInstructions: Payment details are printed on each invoice. Questions about an invoice: finance@cybarq.com.

security.title: Security reports
security.description: Final reports from your security engagements. Working notes and individual findings stay with the engagement team.
security.emptyDescription: Engagements appear here once they are authorised.
security.noReports: No final report has been shared for this engagement yet.

support.title: Support
support.description: Ask a question or report an issue. The team replies by email and updates the status here.
support.newDescription: Describe what you need. Include steps, dates and any references that help us respond quickly.
support.emptyDescription: Requests you submit appear here with their current status.
